dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Single thin white horizontal bar across the greater coverts with high grayscale contrast against the blue flight feathers.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High prominence and sharp boundary sharpness of pale white edges on the outer vanes of the folded primary and secondary feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Small, rectangular white patch situated on the posterior neck.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Distinct and linear boundary where a dark blue-black collar separates the blue crown from the green mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced white cheek patch and dark ocular stripe visible on the lateral head.
